project.name: Structural Evolution
project.summary: A browser-native human-agent physical-engineering workbench where an AI agent uses typed WebMCP tools against the same live design state the human supervises.
project.ai_usage: Typed WebMCP tools let an AI agent inspect and request bounded actions in the shared physical-engineering workbench.
project.codex_usage: OpenAI Codex was used to build, test, and document the project and was tested as a WebMCP client.
